text:
Type: wall shelf with hooks
Use: hanging coats, bags and keys, display on top; entryway, bedroom, living room
Style: industrial, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: solid wood plank, dark riveted metal straps, iron rail
Colors: warm honey wood, dark brown-black metal
Shape: thick wood shelf held by vertical strap brackets, lower rod with five curled hooks, sturdy, medium visual weight
Feel: rugged, warm, practical
Goes with: reclaimed wood, black metal, brick or white walls; industrial or farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Rustic Metal Floating Shelf with 5 Hooks - 13 x 22 x 5 Inch, Black and Wood
product.description: Along with vintage charm, this piece adds a convenient place to hang coats, purses and keys to an entryway or mudroom. The shelf is handy for mail or small objects you want to display. Wood and iron materials provide rustic and industrial touches. 22.5" W x 13" H x 5.75" D Constructed from hardwood and iron Ready to hang, all hardware included
